description: It came down to getting out and meeting voters, and in the end, Tuesday, Woonsocket City Councilwoman Melissa A. Murray claimed the prize of state Senator Marc A. Cote’s Dist. 24 seat representing Woonsocket and North Smithfield. Murray, a Democrat, pulled in 3,239 votes between the two communities
paid_for_by: Paid for by Friends of Melissa Murray
title: Murray wins state Senate seat — Melissa Murray
